mapper.select: SELECT id, first_name, mid_name, last_name, birthday, phone, email FROM patient
mapper.insert:
SELECT nextval('patient_seq')
INSERT INTO patient (id, first_name, mid_name, last_name, birthday, phone, email, search_pattern) VALUES (#{id}, #{firstName}, #{middleName}, #{lastName}, #{birthday}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{searchPattern})
mapper.update: UPDATE patient SET first_name= #{firstName}, mid_name= #{middleName}, last_name= #{lastName}, birthday=#{birthday}, phone= #{phone}, email= #{email}, search_pattern= #{searchPattern} WHERE id= #{id}
